name: web
note: The company: its site and its brand now, and every asset after them. Each asset is generated from facts/company.json, from brand/tokens.json and from the engine it pins - what the product is (its principles, its commands, its version) is read from that release, never retyped here.

facts.why: THE SOURCE: every fact the company states about itself, once

brand.why: THE BRAND: every colour, typeface and radius, once, each with its role and its reason

pendulum.why: THE CASE STUDY'S COUNTS: a dated snapshot of the pendulum's own repository, counted once at the commit it names. The release this corpus pins sweeps only the first source for reach, so checks/case_study.py moves each of these

roadmap.why: THE ENGINE'S ROADMAP, copied: what is next and what is later for the open-source engine, byte for byte the roadmap.json beside its code. The site owns no roadmap; What's next is built from this copy, and `wherefore check upstream` fails the deploy when the engine's file has moved, until the copy is taken again

generators.makes: site/brand.css, the map's theme site/brand/map.css, site/fonts/ and the brand page site/brand/ with the icon, from the brand tokens
site/index.html, site/page.css, site/_headers and the pendulum's framed model site/pendulum/, from the facts, the pendulum's counts and model, the brand and the pinned engine
site/install.sh, the one-line installer wherefore.sh serves, from the pinned release's name, command and Python
.claude/skills/wherefore/, the skill the pinned release ships, for every coding agent that works here

site/map/, the map of this repository: every source, the scripts that read it, and every file they make, drawn by the pinned engine from a real run in the brand's own colours (site/brand/map.css) - the gate runs it like any command, and `wherefore graph` credits it rather than running it

inventory.note: Every tracked file is generated, authored or captured. GENERATED is derived by running the generators - site/, here - and never declared; this declares the rest.

rules: the font files and their licences, third-party and unchanged: each is copied from the npm package brand/tokens.json names, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 its OFL.txt carries
code: the generators, the checks and their proofs
the site's layout, served as site/page.css by gen/site.py; every colour and face in it is a token
prose a person writes about this repository
this file: what this repository is to the engine
the engine release this corpus is built and judged by
the browser library checks/controls_press.py drives, pinned like the engine
the hosting: Cloudflare serves site/ as it is committed, under the project's name

pendulum.no_stamp: counted from another repository, which this gate cannot see and deliberately does not read: the file names the commit and the day it was counted at, and a case study is a dated story, so a person counts again when it is retold
pendulum.why: the case study's counts, a snapshot of the pendulum's repository at one commit

upstream.unreachable: the pendulum's site being down is not a new release: a deploy goes ahead and says so, and the next build reads it again

pendulum-model.no_stamp: copied byte for byte from another repository, which this gate cannot see and deliberately does not read: facts/company.json case.model.taken names the file, the commit and the day, and the pendulum's own suite builds and judges it. The case study is a dated story, so a person copies it again when it is retold
pendulum-model.why: the pendulum's interactive 3D model, the same file its home page embeds, shown beside the case study's heading

upstream.unreachable: the pendulum's site being down is not the pendulum moving: a deploy goes ahead and says so, and the next build reads it again

icon.why: the icon as a picture, for the accounts that take only PNG. Setting type into pixels takes a browser, which the build does not run, so brand/shoot_icon.py shoots it from the SVG gen/brand.py writes. When that SVG moves, shoot it again and run `wherefore gate --restamp icon`

roadmap.no_stamp: copied byte for byte from the engine's repository, which this gate cannot see and deliberately does not read: the engine's own tests hold the file honest, and its upstream below holds this copy to it
roadmap.why: the engine's roadmap, the same file that sits beside its code, which What's next on the features page is built from

upstream.unreachable: GitHub not answering is not the roadmap moving: a deploy goes ahead and says so, and the next build reads it again

facts.why: every fact the company states reaches the site; the note is about the file, for whoever edits it
